scope: Actual Gazebo + RViz + Terminal capture; native author 2D mapping, not a 3D projection. Single short session unless explicit prior present.

audit.static_label_scope: Observed scene support excluding self and moving-box boundary shell; unique 10cm cells
audit.dynamic_label_scope: Historical moving-box support later crossed by a real free ray; current occupancy and static overlap excluded
audit.scope: Single session native author map. Coverage after registration and fusion, not exact source-point deletion; cannot numerically rank against 3D subset metrics.

gif_timing.scope: full interval sampled at 5fps; no speed change; GIF 10ms delay precision

snapshot_export.scope: All clean-map snapshots and timestamps retained; quadratic raw-history duplicates stay in original run and are reconstructible from saved scan+pose inputs
